settings.title: Climate integration
settings.description: Enable K5 climate display and commands, including both front heated and ventilated seats. Restart required.

settings.title: K5 vehicle information and shortcuts
settings.description: Vehicle app readings and installed head-unit app shortcuts. Restart required.

settings.title: Parked AirPlay video
settings.description: Allow video only during an active CarPlay session with fresh Park feedback. Restart required.

settings.title: Volume synchronization
settings.description: Synchronize supported CarPlay audio streams with the head unit. Restart required.

settings.title: Media controls
settings.description: Forward explicit play, pause and track commands. Restart required.

settings.title: Ultra theme
settings.description: Experimental shared CarPlay theme and virtual display profile. Restart required.

settings.title: Comfort thresholds
settings.description: Edit automatic seat heating and ventilation thresholds in CarPlay when compatible Comfort is installed. Restart required.

settings.title: CarPlay volume panel
settings.description: Dismiss the native volume popup after stock volume keys while CarPlay is foreground and volume synchronization is ready. Restart required.
